name: Insulation contractor

ask: The company's registration or license number, and its class
Any job-size limit the license has
General liability insurance; workers' comp where the business has employees
A bond, where the state's form asks for one
pf.license.holder: The business; plus a qualifying person where the state's form names one. Spray foam installers hold their own certification where the state's form asks. Asbestos removal is a separate licensed trade.
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
blocks: No insulation work goes live until the company's registration or license checks out, where one is required
A job over the license's size limit is never offered or quoted: the owner is told why
pf.license.renewals: License, insurance and bond dates kept; reminded 30 days out; a lapse pauses new bookings
pf.license.lead_safe: Work that disturbs paint in homes built before 1978 only by a firm and a person certified for lead-safe work, where the rules require it
pf.license.design_studio: A consult at the office needs no license in most states. The work it leads to is booked under the contractor license.
pf.license.background: Background checks only where the state's form asks

pf.services.capacity: One estimator or advisor per booking; one install crew per job; the office's desk is saved with long sessions
pf.services.skills: Estimates and running a job: crew leads. Energy consults: energy advisors. Spray foam: certified installers. Asbestos removal and electrical fixes: licensed subcontractors.
pf.services.nobody_home: Estimates and small jobs: nobody needs to be home if the attic hatch is reachable. Install days: an adult on the booking is reachable by phone.
pf.services.online: An energy consult can be a video or phone call (counts as at the office)
pf.services.smallest_job: A switch the owner sets: the smallest job taken, with smaller requests pointed elsewhere (the example takes no attic job under $1,500 and sends smaller ones to the list jobs).

before_times: What do you want insulated? (attic, walls, basement or crawl space)
Rough size of the area, or just a guess
The year the home was built (older homes may have old loose-fill or cloth-covered wiring that must be checked first)
after_time: Who will sign the contract? Everyone on the deed should be at the estimate visit
Do you own the home or rent? (the owner must sign)
How is the attic or crawl space reached? Hatch, stairs, a tight space
Any roof leaks, stains or musty smells
Pets at home during the work
secure_page_only: Any special care needs at home during spray foam work
pf.questions.who_may_book: An adult who owns the property, or someone with the owner's written OK. A renter's job needs the owner to sign.
studio: Which area, and a rough budget (on the secure page)

stop.words: gas smell, hissing near a gas line, a burning smell from the attic or a light, sparking or smoking wires, a carbon monoxide alarm
stop.says: Leave the house now. Then call 911 and the gas or power company.
stop.booking: no booking; a new request must say the home was made safe

stop.words: a ceiling sagging or falling, soaked insulation hanging down
stop.says: Stay out of that room, and call 911 if anyone is at risk.

steps_then_go_on.words: water coming through a ceiling or soaking the attic
steps_then_go_on.says: Shut off the water at the main valve if a pipe is leaking. Stay away from wet outlets, lights and switches. Call a roofer or a plumber first.

steps_then_go_on.words: old loose-fill insulation that looks like gray-brown pebbles, or old cloth-covered wiring
steps_then_go_on.says: Don't touch, sweep or vacuum it, and don't go into the attic. We'll test and check first.
steps_then_go_on.booking: goes on; the lab test or an electrician's check becomes a first step

pf.safety.business_line: Questions about an old chimney, a gas appliance's venting or old wiring go to the business's own line

pf.first_steps.before_quote: The estimate visit at the property, with everyone who will sign there
after_contract: The cancel window ends before any work or orders, where the state's rules give one
A lab sample of old loose-fill insulation in older homes, where the rules require it, before anyone disturbs it
The permit, pulled by the license holder in the business's name, where the work needs one
A combustion safety check on gas appliances after air sealing, where the rules require it, and the blown-in material ordered once the window ends
prep: Clear a path to the attic hatch and move boxes away from the hatch
Take down anything stored near the eaves or the attic floor
Keep pets and everyone else out of the work area
Put any lockbox code on the secure page
Spray foam jobs: plan to be out of the house for the time the maker says; the details are on the secure page
studio_prep: Bring photos and rough measurements of the area
Bring any samples or colors you already like

pf.visit.check_in: Estimate visit: the check-in code at the door. Each work day: that day's code, or the lockbox and a start photo when nobody is home. Office: the code at the desk.
pf.visit.at_the_visit: The estimator looks at the attic, walls and crawl space, measures, photographs and checks the old insulation, venting and wiring; the written quote follows within 3 business days, good for 30 days
pf.visit.changes: A written change order, priced and signed by both, before any changed work. Wet insulation, a bath fan venting into the attic, old wiring or mold found are priced this way.
pf.visit.outside_checks: A permit inspection and a final depth and coverage check, where the permit requires them
pf.visit.done: The final depth and coverage check, then the walk-through, then DONE on the last work day; the care notes go with it
pf.visit.studio_done: DONE after the consult, with the energy advisor's notes and the picks saved for the estimate
pf.visit.before_photos: The attic floor, the hatch, the vents and any stains or damage

pf.money.estimate: The example's $89 estimate visit is credited to the job; billed only if no contract follows. A free estimate is the safe start.
pf.money.no_money_before_contract: On project work, nothing is taken before the contract is signed by everyone on the deed
pf.money.deposit: Only after signing; the deposit cap comes from the state's form
pf.money.kept_apart: Money paid before the work is kept apart or bonded where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state's form)
pf.money.stages: Each stage is billed only when it's done and any check has passed: the start, the air sealing and new insulation, the finish. Never ahead of the work
pf.money.last_payment: After the walk-through and the final depth check
pf.money.change_orders: Added to the next stage bill
pf.money.big_bills: Bank transfer through the company's own Stripe, for bills over the owner's amount (the example: $500); paid once it clears. A check also works: the crew lead texts 'paid check'.
pf.money.tax: Tax on materials and labor follows the state's form
pf.money.studio: The energy plan session's $55 is credited to the job if Alex signs; the $20 missed-consult fee only after Sam OKs it

never_in_texts: Contract, change order and permit papers (secure page only, with a copy by email)
pf.messages.minors: Never booked by a minor; a child at home is never the one who lets the crew in

pf.staff.roles: Crew leads (Gil, Marta): estimates, quotes and running the job, with the crew. Energy advisors (Ines, Tomas) at the office.
pf.staff.licenses: The company holds the contractor registration or license. Where the state's form also licenses each person, each one may add a number (optional, shown as given, not checked by Rosie). Subcontractors hold their own, as the business says.
pf.staff.who_oks: Sam OKs quotes and change orders over $500; Pat may OK them too, and Sam's answer wins
pf.staff.stand_in: Another crew lead may take an estimate visit; a job keeps its crew lead unless Sam moves it

pf.rules.contract: A written contract for project work where the state's rules require one, signed by everyone on the deed and by the business before any money
pf.rules.contract_parts: The parts the state's form lists (license number, dates, price, deposit, cancel notice, any lien notice)
pf.rules.cancel_window: A cancel window after signing, where the state's rules give one; work and orders wait for it
pf.rules.permits: Pulled by the license holder in the business's name, never the homeowner's
pf.rules.change_orders: Written and signed by both before the changed work
pf.rules.final: The final depth and coverage check and any permit sign-off before the last payment
pf.rules.lien_waivers: Lien waivers from the business and its subcontractors with the last payment, where the state's rules provide them
pf.rules.show: The license number on the listing, the quote, the contract and the receipt, where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.warranty: 1 year on workmanship (the example's). The material's rated R-value is on the quote; makers' warranties on products.

pf.edges.weather: Spray foam and wet-weather days: the work moves, with no fee; the crew lead checks the forecast the day before
pf.edges.hot_attic: A hot attic: the crew works early in the day, and may move the day with no fee
pf.edges.tight_access: A hatch or a space the crew can't reach safely: the crew lead calls Alex first; the job is re-quoted if it needs more work
pf.edges.vermiculite: Old loose-fill that may contain asbestos: the crew stops and nothing is disturbed; a lab test and licensed removal come first, by their own quote
pf.edges.old_wiring: Cloth-covered wiring found: insulation isn't blown over it; an electrician checks it first, and a change order covers the fix
pf.edges.moisture: Wet insulation, mold or a roof leak found: the crew stops, and Alex is told in writing; the fix is a separate job by the right trade
pf.edges.gas_venting: Gas appliances: venting is checked after air sealing, where the rules require it
pf.edges.spray_foam: Spray foam: the house is empty for the time the maker says, and nobody with breathing trouble stays
pf.edges.permit_late: The start moves with no fee; Alex is told
pf.edges.inspection_fails: The crew fixes it and it's checked again; the next stage and its bill wait
pf.edges.rebate: A utility rebate is the customer's to claim; the quote lists the paperwork the utility asks for, and Rosie promises no rebate
pf.edges.cancel_after_window: Sam and the customer settle it; Rosie moves no money on its own
pf.edges.nobody_home: Estimates and small jobs with the hatch reachable, with start and end photos
pf.edges.over_license_limit: Not offered, and the owner is told why
pf.edges.walk_through_dispute: Goes to Sam; the last bill waits
pf.edges.other: All other edge cases are handled the generic way

notes:
Started from contractor (pattern: project, refitted Tue Oct 27 on the frozen master): an estimate visit, a written quote, then a contract and stage bills. Facts, switches, settings and money paths are the parent's, re-worded for this work: documents, stages, photos, extrawork, firststeps, multiday, banktransfer, video; switch cancelright in flow B only (work sold at the customer's place); arrive A a set start, B a 2-hour window; cutoff 24 hours before.
Flow B main path visit|none|bill: the booking is the $89 estimate visit, credited to the job; Gil's written quote; the contract signed by everyone on the deed; $480 to start, $2,880 when the air sealing is done and the new insulation is in, $1,440 at the finish (a $4,800 attic insulation job). The $89 keeps the master's numbers true (97 master steps hard-code it); a free estimate is the owner's choice (pf.money).
B money paths: visit|none|bill, visit|none|own, visit|card|bill, photos|deposit|bill (Rim joist foam, one wall, $640 from photos, a $160 deposit and $480 after). Left out: list paths. Attic hatch cover ($179) and Pipe insulation wrap ($150) are in pf.services, but the master's booking cards name one list service, so a list path would show the wrong name (MASTER R02/R08).
Flow A is Sam's second company, Lee Energy Desk, Lee Energy Desk, a home energy advice office (the master's Lee's Barbershop). Main path list|card|counter: a $35 energy consult with Ines, a card saved for the $20 missed-consult fee, paid at the office desk. The other three: list|none|counter, list|full|none (energy plan session, $55, credited to the job if Alex signs), list|deposit|counter (whole-home energy plan, $140, $40 deposit and $100 after the visit). Video or phone energy consults are on (fact `video`): the owner's utility bills and attic photos are enough to talk through a plan, so the A4-01 video branch is on.
Own steps: A8-x01 (the energy consult offers the estimate visit at home), B8-x06 to B8-x08 (the permit and a lab sample of old loose-fill insulation go first; a late permit moves the start with no fee; vermiculite that may contain asbestos means a licensed abatement company first, by its own quote) and B8-x11 / B8-x12 (a bath fan venting into the attic: a change order first, signed by both).
Insulation is a hidden-conditions trade: old loose-fill that may contain asbestos is never disturbed (lab sample first, B8-x06 / B8-x08; the result is on the secure page, never in a text), old cloth-covered wiring gets an electrician's check before insulation goes over it (pf.edges old_wiring), wet insulation or a roof leak stops the work (pf.edges moisture), gas appliances' venting is checked after air sealing (pf.first_steps), and spray foam needs the house empty for the time the maker says (pf.edges spray_foam). A burning smell or a gas smell is a stop (pf.safety).
Booking choices: B timing settime, times window; A times setstart. Nothing is sent now: the S2-30 'Yes' branch is off, no `sentnow` fact, and the two rows that spoke of it say so (S2-30's example sentence and S1-21's 'Jobs sent now' row now read that every job is booked ahead). I searched the joined text of all eight paths for the opposite claim: only the master's own conditional lines remain ('A job sent now reads ...' in B6-13, S13-32), hidden branches aside.
Dates (not the parent's): the own steps run forward from the cancel window (ends Tue Oct 27) to the first work day Mon Nov 2: the permit to-do is Wed Oct 28 'due before the first work day, Mon Nov 2'; a late permit Fri Oct 30 with new starts Mon Nov 9 / Mon Nov 16; the trade's surprise at the lab or locate Thu Oct 29; the change order on a work day, Tue Nov 3.
Test results, health and money details stay off texts: the lab or test result is 'on your secure page' in every text (B8-x08), and special care needs at home are asked only on the secure page (pf.questions secure_page_only).
Plug-in splits kept whole (splitsKept): A7-15; B5-34, B7-55, B8-58, B8-69 (as the parent).
Names: Gil and Marta are the crew leads (the master's Jordan and Casey), Ines and Tomas the energy advisors (Riley and Avery). None of them is a master customer's name. Addresses: 620 Quarry Rd (the company), 58 Canal St (the office), 31 Orchard Ln (Alex). License numbers use an obviously fake format (IN-1042, SF-2210, ED-3305; people IL-10552, SF-10417). No state, city or law is named.
Every state rule is a switch from the state's form: the license and its job-size limit, the written contract and its parts, the deposit cap, money kept apart, the cancel window, permits, lien waivers, what must be shown.
keep: color (the master's protected-classes line in S13-40 says 'race, color, religion or sex'), pipe, valve and leak (this trade's own words), the estimate visit, roofing (the work it doesn't do).
Rename: the contractor's pairs re-worded for this work (master sentences first, then phrases, then single words); the barbershop's 'cut' and 'hair' words and its price-board words are turned into this work's words (S1-38, S1-60, S13-55, B8-34); the A3-22 / A3-23 lines that said the plug-in has no danger words now name this work's.
